policy: Do not promote named Catholic devotions into physically distinct shrines from patronage evidence alone.
Reject mismatched nearby OSM features and do not equate an OSM polygon centre with the entrance.

Research-source conflict or qualified alternative does not automatically resolve publication eligibility.
No 1962 Mass venue or visiting-hour inference from institutional identity.
Official street addresses may be added without claiming visitor entrance coordinates; coordinates retain their previous source and precision.
